newsitem.title: USA: Knifefight at N.J. school leaves one dead.
newsitem.headline: Knifefight at N.J. school leaves one dead.

text.p: A knifefight at a New Jersey high school Wednesday left one student dead and another wounded, authorities said.

An unidentifed man wielding a knife stabbed two students in the early morning dispute at Bayonne High School, said Pat Raviola, a spokesman for the Hudson County, New Jersey, District Attorney's office.
One student was stabbed in the heart and pronounced dead at the scene, Raviola said. He was identified as Aubry Taylor, 18.
The second injured student, 17, was stabbed in the chest and was taken to a nearby hospital, where he underwent surgery, he said.
The assailant fled the scene, but police know who he is, Raviola said. He was not a student at the school, said Bayonne police.
The argument apparently erupted over the attacker's car, which Taylor was supposed to be repairing, police said.
